note: a process change rather than a technical one

sections.text: Design review moves from a standing Thursday meeting to an async thread. Anything that changes a screen gets a thread with screenshots before it merges.
Starting with next week's work. The Thursday slot is already off everyone's calendar.
Open the thread when you open the PR, not after review — the point is to catch layout arguments before anyone has written the CSS.
sections.thin: Everyone is kindly asked to familiarise themselves with these new arrangements and to apply them in their day-to-day work, bearing in mind the general objective of improving both the quality of what we ship and the smoothness of how we work together as a team.

sections.text: If nobody has replied in two working days, merge. Silence is approval and we will not be chasing.
Two thirds of the meeting was four people watching two people disagree, and the disagreement was usually about work that had already shipped.
